topic: ONE PRICE IS A TINY WINDOW.
visual: A fictional football fan sees one market price on a TV. The camera dives through the number into a spectacular 3D stadium surrounded by hundreds of market signals, which organize into a MatchSignal interface showing Best Tracked Odds, Market Average, Fair Probability, Estimated Value and Risk Tier.
voiceover: “One price is only a tiny window into the market. MatchSignal helps you see the bigger picture with price, probability and market context.”
